title: Vibration measurements with observer-declared variance change points
description:
Nine smartphone motion-sensor recordings (G-Force Meter, gyroscope, and linear accelerometer) of a person, a motorbike, and a car. Variance changes are induced by gait changes or by a change of road surface (cobblestone versus asphalt). Observer-declared time intervals for structural breaks are included.

These are the vibration measurements analysed in Witulska and Wyłomańska (2022), Identification of the structure break point for data with changing variance, Mathematica Applicanda 50(1), 65–106, https://doi.org/10.14708/ma.v50i1.7155.

creators.name: Witulska, Justyna
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Pure and Applied Mathematics, Hugo Steinhaus Center, Wrocław University of Science and Technology, Wybrzeże Wyspiańskiego 27, 50-370 Wrocław, Poland

notes: Time is elapsed seconds from the start of each recording, not a calendar datetime. Duplicate timestamps come from interleaved multi-sensor logging in Physics Toolbox Sensor Suite and are kept as exported.
